verdict.rationale: Downloading a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for a government business-filing service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only web-based search, filing and PDF downloads. Probes found every OpenAPI/Swagger candidate path returning 404 and no documented public API on the agency's hosts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
